title: Evaluating Agentic Code Repair Capabilities in Distributed Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.14863v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM-based coding agents have advanced rapidly on single-process SWE tasks, with frontier models now clustering in the high-70s on SWE-bench Verified. Distributed-system debugging, however, remains an under-explored regime: bugs span processes, nodes, and protocol interactions, with root causes rarely recoverable from source alone and brute-force exploration intractable across non-deterministic interleavings. This leaves two gaps in LLM and agent evaluation: no code-repair benchmark targets distributed-system bugs, and no controlled study isolates how much externally provided debugging context changes agent success on them. We introduce DDBench, a code-repair benchmark of 60 historical bugs mined from 13 open-source distributed systems, partitioned into three difficulty tiers. translated_title: 评估分布式系统中智能体代码修复能力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14863v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：基于LLM的编码智能体在单进程软件工程任务上取得了快速进展，前沿模型在SWE-bench Verified上的得分已接近70-80分。然而，分布式系统调试仍是一个未被充分探索的领域：错误跨越进程、节点和协议交互，根因通常无法仅从源代码中恢复，且非确定性交错下的暴力搜索难以处理。这导致LLM和智能体评估存在两个空白：没有针对分布式系统错误的代码修复基准，也没有受控研究来隔离外部提供的调试上下文对智能体成功率的独立影响。我们引入了DDBench，一个包含从13个开源分布式系统中挖掘的60个历史错误、分为三个难度级别的代码修复基准。DDBench在两种匹配条件下评估每个案例：仅症状条件（智能体仅接收错误症状和仓库）和上下文条件。
tldr: 本文提出了DDBench，这是首个针对分布式系统错误的代码修复基准，通过60个历史错误和两种受控条件，系统评估了外部调试上下文对LLM智能体修复能力的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DDBench, the first code-repair benchmark targeting distributed-system bugs, which systematically evaluates the impact of external debugging context on LLM agent repair capability using 60 historical bugs under two controlled conditions.
